title: cloud-marketplace-publish-orchestration-and-release-notes-sync
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Objective: Coordinate publication of Redwood Inference listings across AWS Marketplace (SaaS & AMI SKU), Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace; ensure release notes and billing metadata are consistent; verify legal/compliance requirements and console feature flags are aligned.

Scope:
- Finalize marketplace copy, icons, screenshots, and pricing metadata for each provider.
- Align feature mapping to release notes: decide which bullet points appear in vendor listing vs. public release notes.
- Complete required legal attestations, export controls checklist, and privacy disclosures for each marketplace.
- Coordinate Engineering and Release Engineering to schedule final cutover and feature gating via console toggles.
- Validate billing SKU mappings with Finance (AWS Product Codes, Azure Offer IDs, GCP SKU).
- Run post-publish smoke tests for provisioning, SSO flows, and telemetry.

Key deliverables:
- Provider-specific listing assets (copy, 3 screenshots, 1200x600 banner) in Drive: drive.redwood.ai/marketplace-assets/PM-4412 (placeholder).
- Final release notes artifact (single-source-of-truth): Confluence: confluence.redwood.ai/display/RELEASES/marketplace-2026.03 (link for review).
- Marketplace launch checklist (signed off by Legal, Security, Finance, Eng, Design).

Acceptance criteria:
- Listings approved by Legal and Security for each marketplace.
- Release notes published and referenced in each listing where allowed.
- Billing SKUs validated and mapped to telemetry events.
- No critical regressions in provisioning or auth flows after publish.

Risks / trade-offs:
- AWS Marketplace requires a longer review window for SaaS offers; decision: prioritize AWS AMI/bring-your-own first for faster listing, and stage SaaS listing in a second wave (see comment 2026-02-24).
- Some marketing language must be softened for Azure regulated customers — may reduce specificity in listing bullets and rely on linked whitepaper for details.

Instructions for partners/ops:
- Release Eng (Dan Li) to prepare rollback playbook and console flag to disable marketplace-specific onboarding.
- Support to prepare canned responses for provisioning delays and integration FAQs.

Notes: keep this ticket as the coordination single-source; create sub-issues for provider-specific gating and assets.
notes_for_engineering: Engineering tasks: 1) Add marketplace-specific telemetry tags (marketplace.provider, offer_id). 2) Ensure provisioning API returns provider_offer_id in response. 3) Provide a small smoke-test harness (curl examples) for each provider. Reference PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2894, https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1027.
design_notes: Design to supply 3 hero screenshots per provider and a high-contrast banner. Consider localized screenshots (en-US, en-GB) for AWS EU/UK regions. Drive folder: drive.redwood.ai/marketplace-assets/designs/PM-4412.
legal_notes: Legal (Priya Patel) requested export control checklist completion and a short privacy paragraph for listing metadata. Draft sent for review: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/LEGAL/Marketplace+attestations (see section 'SaaS Attestation').
qa_acceptance_test_plan: - Provision new account via AWS SaaS SKU and validate token exchange. - Validate Azure offer leads to correct subscription flow. - Confirm GCP Marketplace deployment returns correct telemetry. - Run basic inference end-to-end (sample prompt) and validate latency under threshold. - Log any failures in #marketplace-launch channel and tag PM-4412.
